column1: 'Freedom came early. Unity came at a price.'
'A union is not inherited. It is built, argued over, and defended.'
'The monsoon binds the ports, the rails bind the provinces, and policy must bind the nation.'
'An army for a continent must learn to move before it learns to strike.'
'The Indian Ocean is not a moat. It is the road by which every great power reaches Asia.'
'Industry is strategy measured in steel, power, and time.'
'The frontier is quiet only until another capital decides that it should not be.'
'Neutrality without strength is merely a request.'
'Every alliance offers security, and every alliance presents a bill.'
'A budget is the first battlefield on which strategy is tested.'
'The world war may begin elsewhere, but Asia will decide how India remembers it.'
'Before midnight, a continent chose to remain whole.'
